ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   D. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   C. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   D. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment School cleanliness.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.
   B. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
   D. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Birth of Prophet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
